Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**SILVER FEATHERED DRAGON**
*Gargantuan dragon (metallic), lawful good*
**AC** 22 (natural armor)
**HP** 574 (28d20 + 280)
**Speed** 60 ft., fly 120 ft.
**STR** 30 (+10) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 30 (+10) | **INT** 21 (+5) | **WIS** 18 (+4) | **CHA** 26 (+8)
**Saving Throws** Dex +10, Con +18, Wis +12, Cha +16
**Skills** Arcana +13, History +13, Perception +30, Stealth +10
**Immunities** cold
**Condition Immunities** charmed, frightened, exhaustion, paralyzed
**Senses** truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 30
**Languages** Common, Draconic
**CR** 25 (75,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +8

**QUALITY TRAITS**
*Eidolic*

**TRAITS**
***Uncanny Frost.*** Cold damage from the dragon ignores resistances, and immunity to cold damage only reduces the damage to half instead. This does not apply to damage the dragon might deal to itself.

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS** (4 uses)
TBA

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The dragon makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 18 (3d12) cold damage.

***Claw.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is restrained and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappling a creature it cannot make Claw attacks except one each turn against the grappled creature.

***Tail.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (2d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

***Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6).*** The dragon uses one of its breath weapon options (Seizing Rapture or Tundra Burial).
• ***Seizing Rapture.*** The dragon exhales paralytic gas in a 300-foot-cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 hour. Creatures paralyzed this way can reattempt the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.
• ***Tundra Burial.*** The dragon exhales a sphere of swirling frost at a point it can see within 300 feet, which explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere of freezing cold winds. All creatures within range must make a DC 26 Constitution saving throw, taking 72 (12d12) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Change Shape.*** The dragon transforms into any creature that is Medium, Small or Tiny, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size), though if it is Tiny it cannot use its multiattack. This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

**REACTIONS**
***Beyond the Web (Recharge 5-6).*** When one or more creatures within 120 feet of the feathered dragon is targeted by the same magical effect or spell (except itself), the feathered dragon may grant them a +5 bonus on the first save they make against it.

***Freezing Shell.*** When the dragon or a creature within 60 feet of it is targeted by an attack or effect, the dragon can cause a shell of hard ice to form around them, granting them total cover until the end of the turn. If an attack hits the creature or they fail a Dexterity save against an effect despite being behind cover, the shell shatters.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Attack.*** The dragon makes one Claw or Tail attack.
***Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions).*** The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (1d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) cold damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
***Freezing Flight (Costs 3 Actions).*** The dragon causes ice to erupt on the ground at a point it can see within 240 feet of itself, where it spreads out in a 30-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or have its movement speed reduced to 0 by cloying ice until the end of their next turn. Creatures immune to cold damage are unaffected.
